fact_english: Each eyeball of a tarsier is about as large as its entire brain.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang tarsier, par: bawat mata niya, halos kasinlaki ng buong utak niya!

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Kaya pala ganyan tumitig. Puro mata, konting isip. Parang ikaw tuwing umaga.

after_text: Sabi niya, kung hindi ko kinuha, hindi ito makakarating sa'yo.
why_here: After M's 'kung hindi ko kinuha, hindi ito makakarating sa'yo': the next sentence opens the umbrella, so the viewer waits through the break to see what is inside.
